one_liner.title: One Liner (RHP)
one_liner.body: A high-reliability, mission-critical electronics systems design and manufacturing (ESDM) company serving India's strategic defence and aerospace programmes.

business_model.title: What they do
business_model.body: Merritronix is a B2B ESDM company specializing in high-reliability, mission-critical electronic assemblies and systems for defence, aerospace, telecommunications and specialized industrial electronics. Its integrated offering spans component sourcing, PCB (SMT/THT) assembly, system integration, testing and box-build/finished-product delivery, executed to defence and aerospace quality standards. Revenue is derived from turnkey manufacturing/build-to-print, obsolescence engineering management, trading sales and job work.

group_structure.title: Group structure (subsidiaries / JV / related parties)
group_structure.body:
- Merrictro Products Private Limited — Group Company: Registered at APIIC Industrial Park, Auto Nagar, Nuzvid, Andhra Pradesh; Mr. Dovari Yesudas is a director
- Merrito Polymers (India) Private Limited — Group Company: Registered at APIIC Industrial Park, Auto Nagar, Nuzvid, Andhra Pradesh; Mr. Dovari Yesudas is a director

products.title: Products & brands
products.body:
- **Manufacturing services:** Turnkey Manufacturing / Build-to-Print (end-to-end electronic product execution), Job Work (PCB assembly, soldering, testing, sub-assembly on customer-supplied designs/materials), Obsolescence engineering management (component re-sourcing, reverse engineering, system redesign), Trading Sales (procurement and resale of electronic/electromechanical components)
- **Capabilities:** Surface-Mount Technology (SMT) assembly incl. BGA and micro-BGA, Through-Hole Technology (THT) assembly, Box-build and system integration, Mechanical enclosure fabrication (via third-party vendors)

end_markets.title: End Markets (RHP)
end_markets.body:
- Aerospace & Defence (97.81% of revenue from operations in FY2026)
- Complex PCBA & NPI (2.00% in FY2026)
- Micro Electronics (0.16% in FY2026)
- Medical Electronics (0.03% in FY2026)

certifications.title: Certs (RHP)
certifications.body:
- EN 9100:2018 (for manufacturing of PCBAs for aerospace and defence; equivalent to AS 9100D and JISQ 9100:2016, includes ISO 9001:2015)
- IPC-A-610 Class 3 process qualification

cost_leadership.title: Supply chain integration (RHP report)
cost_leadership.body: Integrated in-house B2B ESDM model spanning component sourcing, PCB assembly (SMT and through-hole), system integration, functional/reliability testing, quality assurance, box-build and delivery of finished electronic products under a single coordinated customer interface, providing end-to-end component traceability. Mechanical enclosure fabrication and related processes are outsourced to third-party vendors where required. Components are procured from a network of authorized global suppliers, with long-lead or supply-constrained critical parts pre-emptively stocked (trading sales segment) to mitigate supply-chain risk and reduce lead times. The Company states a strategic progression up the value chain toward higher-complexity turnkey and obsolescence-management engagements and intends to strengthen system-level design and participate in Joint Manufacturing Models (JMM).

demand_drivers.title: Demand & outlook drivers
demand_drivers.body:
- Revenue mix shift toward the higher-margin Aerospace & Defence segment (52.94% of revenue in FY2023 to 88.50% in FY2025)
- Operating leverage as a relatively stable fixed/semi-fixed cost base (employee, finance, depreciation, admin) was absorbed over a larger revenue base
- Growth in turnkey projects and complex defence assemblies commanding higher value addition versus standalone component supply
- Strong repeat-customer base contributing approximately 80% to 94% of total customers, aiding revenue visibility
- Execution of larger and higher-value orders; improved profitability lowering debt-equity ratio from 1.93x (FY24) to 0.81x (FY26)

capital_allocation.title: Strategy & capital allocation
capital_allocation.body:
- Deliberate strategic progression up the electronics manufacturing value chain toward higher-complexity, higher-value programme engagements
- Shift business mix toward higher-margin turnkey manufacturing/build-to-print engagements
- Position as a specialist obsolescence-management provider to the Indian armed forces and defence PSU supply chain
- Capacity expansion funded via IPO capex on machinery and equipment

capex_expansion.title: Capex & expansion plans
capex_expansion.body: The Company intends to deploy IPO net proceeds towards capital expenditure on machinery and equipment (up to Rs. 2,136.43 lakhs, planned for FY2026-27) to expand its Hyderabad manufacturing capacity. Its installed capacity as on March 31, 2026 was 10,75,000 boards p.a. for SMT, 6,00,000 boards p.a. for THT and 4,20,000 units p.a. for box build, aggregating 17,85,000 production units per annum. Growth is being driven by increased order volumes from defence and aerospace customers, capacity expansion and a progressive shift toward higher-value turnkey manufacturing.

moat.title: Bull — competitive strengths
moat.body:
- Three decades of operating legacy in mission-critical defence and aerospace electronics (low-volume, high-complexity, high-reliability niche)
- High entry barriers: EN 9100:2018 (AS 9100D) certification, IPC-A-610 Class 3 qualification and mission-critical delivery track record typically take 18-24 months to obtain
- Integrated execution framework unifying sourcing, assembly, testing and quality control, supporting component traceability required in defence/aerospace
- Established track record delivering imaging infrared seeker assemblies for missile systems, electronic assemblies for airborne radar systems and digital video recording systems for defence aircraft
- Dedicated obsolescence management capability serving legacy defence platform lifecycle extension
- Deep aerospace & defence integration (97.81% of FY2026 revenue) with a strong base of repeat customers

risks.title: Bear — key risks
risks.body:
- B2B contract-manufacturing model with limited brand recognition — May restrict pricing power, customer diversification and growth; Company does not own the IP in products it manufactures and has limited control over specifications, pricing and product life cycles
- Customer concentration — Revenues are substantially derived from a concentrated customer base and dependent on purchase orders, programme awards and contract renewals rather than diversified end-consumer demand
- End-market concentration in Aerospace & Defence — Aerospace & defence applications accounted for 97.81% of FY2026 revenue, exposing the Company to defence budget/programme cycles
- Geographic revenue concentration — Telangana contributed 98.19% of revenue in FY2026, concentrating operational and demand risk
- Dependence on order flow and contract renewals — Any reduction, delay, modification or cancellation of purchase orders or programme awards could adversely affect operations
- Dependence on key promoters/management — Company relies heavily on long-tenured promoter-directors (Mr. Dovari Amarnath and Mr. Dovari Yesudas) for technical and strategic leadership

commitments.title: Promises (RHP)
commitments.body:
- **Deploy IPO net proceeds of up to Rs. 2,136.43 lakhs on capital expenditure for purchase of machinery and equipment, to be utilised in FY2026-27.**
- **Fund working capital requirements with up to Rs. 2,195.21 lakhs of IPO net proceeds in FY2026-27.**
- **Repay/prepay, in full or part, outstanding borrowings using up to Rs. 1,271.92 lakhs of IPO net proceeds in FY2026-27.**
- **Continue a deliberate strategic progression up the electronics manufacturing value chain toward higher-complexity, higher-value programme engagements.**
- **Scale a dedicated obsolescence management capability to serve the growing legacy-platform lifecycle demand across the Indian armed forces and defence PSU supply chain.**
- **Expand Hyderabad manufacturing capacity beyond the 17,85,000 production-unit-per-annum installed base via machinery capex funded by the IPO.**

strategy.title: Strategies (RHP)
strategy.body:
- Deliberate strategic progression up the electronics manufacturing value chain toward higher-complexity, higher-value programme engagements
- Shift business mix toward higher-margin turnkey manufacturing/build-to-print engagements
- Position as a specialist obsolescence-management provider to the Indian armed forces and defence PSU supply chain
- Capacity expansion funded via IPO capex on machinery and equipment
